A thirsty traveler notices a tall cliff at a distance and begins approaching the cliff for its shade. The traveler's falcon soaring in the clear skies follows closely. As the man advances toward the cliff he notices a steady drip of clear fluid from up high. He quickly places a small container on the ground and waits as it collects the fluid. When the container was full, he carefully raised it off the ground and just before it reaches his mouth the falcon drops down and knocks the container out of his hands emptying the fluid onto the dry earth. Confused, he places the container under the source again and guards it closely. When it filled up he raises the container and the falcon knocks it down a second time. He pulls out his sward out of frustration and fills the container once more. He was careful to spot his falcon before attempting to drink the fluid. As soon as he stood up straight he saw the falcon falling towards him. He immediately drops the container and with both hands on the sward slices through the bird killing it instantly. In a hurry, he puts the container back for one last filling. Listening to the splashing of the drops the man starts to wonder about his falcon's strange behavior. He becomes increasingly curious and after some thought, he decides to find the fluid source. After a dangerous climb toward the sky he reaches the peak of the cliff. Next to him lay a defeated snake whose poisonous juice sweat out over the rocky formation.
